general.shortcutError: Couldn't use that shortcut. Try another.

advanced.startHiddenTip: Open to the menu bar without showing this window. Needs the menu bar icon.
advanced.launchOnStartupTip: Start Audible automatically when you log in.
advanced.showMenuBarIconTip: Show Audible in the menu bar. When hidden, reopen Audible from Launchpad or Finder.
advanced.removeFillerWordsTip: Removes fillers like “um”, “uh”, “ờ”, “ừm” and repeated stutters. Done on this Mac.
advanced.interfaceLanguageTip: Changes the app's text only. Speech is always detected automatically as English or Vietnamese.
advanced.cleanAndReformatTip: After transcription, Groq removes fillers and false starts and formats the text for the app you're in. Sends the transcript, your dictionary, and the frontmost app name and window title to Groq. Needs a Groq API key.
advanced.groqApiKeyTip: Stored in the macOS Keychain, never in Audible's settings file. Get a key at console.groq.com.
advanced.keySaveFailed: Couldn't save the key to the Keychain.
advanced.keyRemoveFailed: Couldn't remove the key from the Keychain.
advanced.keyInvalid: That key isn't valid. Check it and try again.
advanced.keyUnreachable: Couldn't reach Groq. Check your connection and try again.
advanced.cleanNeedsKey: Get a free key at console.groq.com/keys, paste it in the field below, press Save, then turn this on.

microphone.title: Allow microphone access
microphone.body: Audible listens only while you hold or toggle your shortcut. Your voice is transcribed on this Mac.

accessibility.title: Allow Accessibility access
accessibility.body: Audible needs Accessibility to detect your shortcut from any app and to paste the text where you are typing. Turn on Audible in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.

model.title: Download speech model
model.body: Audible needs a {{size}} speech model. It downloads once and then runs fully offline.

errors.network: The download was interrupted. Check your connection and retry; it will resume where it stopped.
errors.stalled: The download stopped receiving data. Retry to resume.
errors.checksum: The downloaded file was damaged. Retry to download it again.
errors.disk_space: Not enough disk space. Free up about 2 GB and retry.
errors.server: The download server returned an error. Try again later.
errors.io: The model couldn't be saved. Retry.
